title: Cross-rail latency comparator for model routes (stream vs non-stream)
creator: Aditi Kapoor
description: Goal: build a cross-rail comparator dashboard that decomposes latency (p50/p95/p99) by model and API route, with a clear streaming vs non-streaming view and quick drilldowns into traces/logs. Background: current boards show per-route percentiles but mix streaming and blocking calls which hides regressions for conversation workloads. This ticket will: (1) define metrics and tag schema, (2) add OpenTelemetry tracing hooks to mark stream-start/stream-end and per-chunk timing, (3) standardize logs/metrics ingest (OTel -> Cortex/Prometheus, logs -> Loki/Cloudwatch), and (4) implement Grafana/Console panels with interactive split toggles and trace links. Acceptance criteria: 1) P50/P95/P99 for each model+route shown with streaming/non-streaming stacked bars and separate percentiles; 2) clicking a cell opens filtered traces (trace id list + time window); 3) percentiles computed from representative cardinality-limited histograms (no high-cardinality explosion); 4) alerting recipe for p95 drift (>20% vs baseline) and an on-call runbook link; 5) dashboard load <1s for default time window (1h). Implementation notes: - Metric tags: service, model_family, model_version, route, io_mode (streaming|blocking), request_shape (short|mid|long) - Tracing: add otel attribute serve.path and serve.io_mode; for streaming add events for first-chunk-ms and last-chunk-ms - Sampling: keep 10% head-sampling but preserve all error traces and tail samples using tail-based sampling hook - Storage: use histogram_buckets with hdr-like histograms exported via OpenTelemetry; convert to prometheus-compatible summaries in Cortex - Avoid naive per-model cardinality by rolling up model_family for trend panels and providing model_version filter only on demand Rollout plan: - Stage 1: infra changes + OTel attributes deployed to canary services (two routes) - Stage 2: metrics ingestion and histogram transform in staging Cortex - Stage 3: dashboard panels + trace link wiring in Console - Stage 4: soft launch to internal@ and monitor for 48h - Stage 5: public launch and PR to docs
